newsitem.title: USA: Port conditions update - U.S. - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - U.S. - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

UNITED STATES, July 16 - Los Angeles - Work in the port gradually ground to a halt over July 12-13, as 11 port pilots went on strike and members of the International Longshore and Warehouse Union refused to cross picket lines. By Monday evening there were 11 vessels tied up at berth without any longshore workers to handle them, and eight vessels at anchorage.
Attorneys for the city and the Pacific Maritime Association, which represents waterfront employees were attempting to get the Longshore workers and pilots back on the job.
